sections.h2: Two kinds of Lake City homes, two prep plans
body: In subdivisions like Quail Heights and Hidden Acres, houses are newer and the problems are predictable. Builder-grade flat paint scuffs easily, caulk at the windows has shrunk, and the sunny sides have faded. For these homes, residential painting in Lake City, FL mostly means upgrading to washable finishes inside and a 100% acrylic system outside.

Historic homes near downtown are a different job. Old coatings have built up in layers, some edges are lifting, and wood trim has had decades of weather. On those porches and window casings, loose paint comes off until what remains is tight, the edges get feathered with sandpaper, and any bare wood takes primer before color goes on. Rotted trim gets replaced, not hidden. For details on porch and window trim, see our guide to painting trim and shutters.

sections.h2: Staying put in your Lake City house during the repaint
body: Nobody has to pack a bag or book a motel. Our painters shift the couches and dressers themselves, drape them, and finish one bedroom or living area before opening up the next, which leaves the rest of your home in normal use. Expect roughly a day for a single room; a full interior on a Lake City house stretches from three days up to two weeks, with size and the amount of drywall or trim repair deciding where it lands. If someone at home reacts to paint smell, ask for the low-VOC options. The same crews cover every neighborhood listed on our Lake City service area page, from Annie Mattox Park to Eastside Village.

sections.h2: Pairing Columbia County weather with an inside-and-out schedule
body: Many homeowners book both halves at once so the colors work together. Lake City's cooler, drier stretch from October through May is when we prefer to have crews on the siding, which leaves the hot summer for rooms and hallways. Outside, plan on three to seven working days on the walls and trim themselves, with pressure washing and drying time on top of that. You can read more about the outside scope on our Lake City exterior painting page, or about rooms on our interior painting in Lake City page.

sections.h2: How a Lake City job gets signed off
body: The last step is a walk through the house with you, punch list in hand, and your signature closes it out only after every item on that list has been corrected. We leave the leftover paint labelled by room, and the exterior work carries a written workmanship warranty lasting as long as 10 years, separate from and in addition to what the paint manufacturer covers. See how we handle homes across the region on our main residential painting page.

faqs.q: Do I need to leave my Lake City home while it is painted?
faqs.a: No. Families in Lake City generally live at home straight through the job, since the crew handles moving and covering furniture and keeps the work to one room at a time.

faqs.q: Can you match the original colors on an older downtown home?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. Bring us a chip, pull a cabinet door, or find the old can, and we will mix to it, then paint a full-size drawdown so you can judge the shade against the house before anything goes on the walls.

faqs.q: How many days does a full Lake City repaint take?
faqs.a: Interiors land somewhere from three days to two weeks for the whole house. The exterior adds three to seven working days, not counting the wash and the drying time afterward. Your estimate lists the schedule.

faqs.q: Do you fix rotted trim before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Replacing rotten trim or fascia happens during prep, and the boards involved are itemized on your written estimate so there are no surprises once we start.
